subject: Math
prompt:
$$9x - 6y = 3$$

$$5x - 10y = 11$$

If the ordered pair $(x, y)$ is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of $4x + 4y$?
explanation: Choice B is correct. Subtracting the second equation, $5x - 10y = 11$, from the first equation, $9x - 6y = 3$, results in $(9x - 6y) - (5x - 10y) = 3 - 11$, or $9x - 6y - 5x + 10y = -8$. Combining like terms on the left-hand side of this equation yields $4x + 4y = -8$.
